articles.summary: Questie is an AI gaming companion that watches your screen with an AI vision model and talks back in real time via voice chat. Here's how it works and who it's for.
articles.title: Questie AI Review: The AI Gaming Companion With Voice Chat and Screen Vision

articles.summary: From portfolio analysis to fraud detection and automated trading, AI is now employed in nearly every financial market. Bitcoin is no exception. Some traders, researchers, and crypto platforms are applying machine learning models to analyze price history, social sentiment, exchange flows, ETF demand, macro data, and on‑chain indicators. The idea is straightforward: if AI can handle the data load that a human can't, then perhaps it can predict Bitcoin better, as well.
articles.title: Can AI Really Predict Bitcoin Price, or Just Overfit the Past?

articles.summary: Open‑source models like Llama, Mistral, or Falcon have given developers incredible freedom. You no longer have to wait for access to someone else's API. You can take a pretrained model and fine‑tune it for your own tasks. But here comes the real challenge: fine‑tuning can require significant computing resources.
articles.title: Hardware Requirements for Fine‑Tuning Open‑Source AI Models: Choosing the Right Computing Power
